description:
Hello Team,

Please find below the resource allocation and placement details for our upcoming media streaming deployment. The HLS edge component will be scheduled on a unique host (constraint = “hostname:UNIQUE”), will use 0.2 CPU shares, 256 MB of memory, and should run on nodes assigned the **edge** role. The HLS origin service has no specific placement constraints, is allocated 0.15 CPU shares, 128 MB of memory, and must run on nodes with the **origin** role. Likewise, the RTMP origin will also be bound to a unique host, will receive 0.2 CPU shares, 256 MB of memory, and run on **origin** nodes. The RTMP transcoder does not require any placement constraints, is allocated 0.5 CPU shares, 512 MB of memory, and is to be deployed on nodes with the **transcoder** role.

The central dispatcher service (named “dispatcher”) is configured with a unique‑host constraint, 0.1 CPU shares, 128 MB of memory per instance, and we will run two instances of it. It may be placed on any node regardless of role (role = “*”).

Let me know if any adjustments are needed before we apply these settings.
